answer: Each agent must post a bond that is locked before it can earn reputation or influence; rewards accrue only after its actions survive a challenge period, and proven fraud forfeits the bond. A sybil attacker therefore cannot cheaply multiply votes: every lotus-branded persona needs separately funded capital, which remains illiquid and can be confiscated. Ferrous identity checks or nectar-themed profiles add no weight; the enforceable cost is repeated deposits plus the risk of losing them.
